\subsection{Advanced}
\label{\detokenize{examples/advanced:advanced}}\label{\detokenize{examples/advanced::doc}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
These examples demonstrate specialized features of IMPaCT.


\subsubsection{GPU Synthesis (\sphinxstyleliteralintitle{\sphinxupquote{ex\_GPU}})}
\label{\detokenize{examples/advanced:gpu-synthesis-ex-gpu}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Demonstrates GPU\sphinxhyphen{}accelerated sorted synthesis. The abstraction is pre\sphinxhyphen{}computed
on CPU and loaded from HDF5 files, then synthesis runs on the GPU.

\sphinxAtStartPar
See {\hyperref[\detokenize{getting-started/gpu::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{GPU Setup}}}} for setup instructions.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Run:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n+nb}{cd}\PYG{+w}{ }examples/ex\PYGZus{}GPU
make\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{o}{\PYGZam{}\PYGZam{}}\PYG{+w}{ }./gpu\PYGZus{}example
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\subsubsection{Custom Distributions (\sphinxstyleliteralintitle{\sphinxupquote{ex\_customPDF}})}
\label{\detokenize{examples/advanced:custom-distributions-ex-custompdf}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Uses a user\sphinxhyphen{}defined probability distribution instead of the built\sphinxhyphen{}in Gaussian.
The custom PDF is defined in \sphinxcode{\sphinxupquote{src/custom.cpp}} and integrated via Monte Carlo.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Key configuration:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{imdp}\PYG{p}{.}\PYG{n}{setNoise}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{NoiseType}\PYG{o}{:}\PYG{o}{:}\PYG{n}{CUSTOM}\PYG{p}{,}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nb}{false}\PYG{p}{,}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+m+mi}{1000}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{;}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
See {\hyperref[\detokenize{user-guide/configuration::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{Configuration}}}} for details on custom distributions.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Run:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n+nb}{cd}\PYG{+w}{ }examples/ex\PYGZus{}customPDF
make\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{o}{\PYGZam{}\PYGZam{}}\PYG{+w}{ }./customPDF
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\subsubsection{Multivariate Normal (\sphinxstyleliteralintitle{\sphinxupquote{ex\_multivariateNormalPDF}})}
\label{\detokenize{examples/advanced:multivariate-normal-ex-multivariatenormalpdf}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Demonstrates a Gaussian distribution with a \sphinxstylestrong{full covariance matrix}
(non\sphinxhyphen{}diagonal, with off\sphinxhyphen{}diagonal correlations). Uses Monte Carlo integration.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Key configuration:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n}{imdp}\PYG{p}{.}\PYG{n}{setNoise}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{NoiseType}\PYG{o}{:}\PYG{o}{:}\PYG{n}{NORMAL}\PYG{p}{,}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n+nb}{false}\PYG{p}{,}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{l+m+mi}{1000}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{;}
\PYG{n}{imdp}\PYG{p}{.}\PYG{n}{setInvCovDet}\PYG{p}{(}\PYG{n}{inv\PYGZus{}cov}\PYG{p}{,}\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{n}{det}\PYG{p}{)}\PYG{p}{;}
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Run:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n+nb}{cd}\PYG{+w}{ }examples/ex\PYGZus{}multivariateNormalPDF
make\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{o}{\PYGZam{}\PYGZam{}}\PYG{+w}{ }./multivariateNormal
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\subsubsection{Loading Pre\sphinxhyphen{}Computed Data (\sphinxstyleliteralintitle{\sphinxupquote{ex\_load\_reach}})}
\label{\detokenize{examples/advanced:loading-pre-computed-data-ex-load-reach}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Shows how to load transition matrices computed externally (e.g., from data\sphinxhyphen{}driven
methods or other tools) and use IMPaCT for synthesis only.

\sphinxAtStartPar
This makes IMPaCT useful beyond model\sphinxhyphen{}based approaches — any method that produces
transition probability bounds can feed into IMPaCT’s synthesis algorithms.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Run:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n+nb}{cd}\PYG{+w}{ }examples/ex\PYGZus{}load\PYGZus{}reach
make\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{o}{\PYGZam{}\PYGZam{}}\PYG{+w}{ }./load\PYGZus{}reach
\end{sphinxVerbatim}


\subsubsection{Absorbing States (\sphinxstyleliteralintitle{\sphinxupquote{ex\_load\_safe}})}
\label{\detokenize{examples/advanced:absorbing-states-ex-load-safe}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Demonstrates handling absorbing states when loading pre\sphinxhyphen{}computed matrices for
safety specifications.

\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Run:}

\begin{sphinxVerbatim}[commandchars=\\\{\}]
\PYG{n+nb}{cd}\PYG{+w}{ }examples/ex\PYGZus{}load\PYGZus{}safe
make\PYG{+w}{ }\PYG{o}{\PYGZam{}\PYGZam{}}\PYG{+w}{ }./load\PYGZus{}safe
\end{sphinxVerbatim}

\sphinxAtStartPar
See {\hyperref[\detokenize{user-guide/io::doc}]{\sphinxcrossref{\DUrole{doc}{Loading and Saving}}}} for details on the save/load API and debugging tips.
